base_training.loss_positions: all shifted next-token positions in each 24-token window

residual_training.base_logits: frozen base LM final context position only
residual_training.target: single token immediately following the 24-token context

structure_mapping.ambiguity_action: neutralize structural cards for that token
structure_mapping.aggregation: mean pair_bias_components over every ordered non-self token pair

shuffle.permutation_application: feature vectors only; base logits, targets and context order remain fixed

invariants: zero-init exact-base on all 16 validation contexts before residual training
base state_dict SHA256 identical before and after both residual trainings
post-training zero-structural exact-base on all 16 validation contexts for both residual experts
real and shuffled experts start from exact zero independently
